xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
The 10-second deadline is checked around awaits; it does not cap an individual awaited refill.
Foreground HTTP reply lies inside its parallel operand and does not wait for background completion unless the terminal guard requires it.
Refill failure logs in the detached path; terminal failures propagate. Semantic candidate failure is a scoped fallback, not a DB-only ranking step.
